channel_id.description: The numeric Discord channel or thread ID (e.g. "1080123456789012345"). Resolve a name to an ID with Find Channel or List Channels.

request_approval_message.beforeRequest:

discord_find_member.label: Find Member
discord_find_member.description: Search server members by the start of their username or nickname.

guild_id.label: Server
guild_id.description: Only servers the bot has been added to are listed.

query.label: Query
query.description: Username or nickname prefix to match (e.g. "jane"). Matched against the start of the name.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Max members to return, 1-1000. Defaults to 10.

discord_find_member.afterResponse:
const members = (response || []).map(m => ({user_id: m.user?.id, username: m.user?.username, global_name: m.user?.global_name ?? null, nick: m.nick ?? null, joined_at: m.joined_at ?? null, roles: m.roles ?? []}));
return {members, count: members.length};

discord_list_messages.label: List Messages
discord_list_messages.description: Read recent messages from a channel.

channel_id.label: Channel ID
channel_id.description: The numeric channel ID. Resolve a name with Find Channel.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Max messages to return, 1-100. Defaults to 50.

before.label: Before Message ID
before.description: Return messages before this message ID. Mutually exclusive with After and Around.

after.label: After Message ID
after.description: Return messages after this message ID. Mutually exclusive with Before and Around.

around.label: Around Message ID
around.description: Return messages around this message ID. Mutually exclusive with Before and After.

discord_list_messages.afterResponse:
const messages = (response || []).map(m => ({id: m.id, content: m.content, author_id: m.author?.id, author_username: m.author?.username, pinned: m.pinned, timestamp: m.timestamp, edited_timestamp: m.edited_timestamp}));
return {messages, count: messages.length};
